evidence.title: designlang — Open-source design extractor (design-extractor.com alternative). Tokens, Tailwind, Figma, MCP, iOS, Android, Flutter, WordPress.

name: designlang
summary: Open-source CLI that extracts a complete design system — DTCG tokens, Tailwind, Figma, motion — from any live website.
description: Points a headless Chromium browser at any URL and reads colors, typography, spacing, motion and component anatomy off the rendered DOM. One run emits 17+ files: W3C DTCG tokens, Tailwind config, shadcn theme, Figma variables, CSS variables, native iOS SwiftUI / Android Compose / Flutter / WordPress emitters and a brand-book PDF. A stdio MCP server and generated AGENTS.md / .cursorrules / Claude skills feed the result to AI coding agents.
contains: one command emits 17+ files: DTCG tokens, Tailwind config, shadcn theme, Figma variables, motion tokens, prompts
site states 26 capabilities / 11 output formats / 3 MCP-aware editors · $0 · MIT
whole-site crawl synthesizes one canonical system with coverage grades (site-wide / section / page-local)
fidelity score compares a clone against the original — pixel-diff plus motion
native emitters: iOS SwiftUI, Android Compose, Flutter ThemeData, WordPress block theme, brand-book PDF
stdio MCP server; writes AGENTS.md, .cursorrules and Claude skills
WCAG remediation suggests the smallest hue-shift that passes AA
hosted demo rate-limited to 2 extractions per IP per day; CLI unlimited
